text.title: 椅子旁的第二次谈话
text.situation:
米娜把两把椅子从墙边拉出来。伊莱抱着包坐下，杰伊去拿维修卡。他先前的回答唐突，伊莱仍因问题被轻视而不满。杰伊道歉，没有再找借口。米娜没有试图用另买一个包的折扣安抚伊莱，而是提出当天下午免费改好接缝。杰伊清楚写下安排，确认伊莱五点能回来。这没有消除全部不满，却给双方一个具体可约定的办法。伊莱再次回来时，内衬已经平整。杰伊先让他看修好的接缝，再去拿纸袋。

伊莱的取件便条
为弥补接缝维修错误，我们今天会改好内衬，不再收费。
下午五点后取件。带包回家前，请与杰伊一起检查维修结果。

paragraphs.en: Mina pulled two chairs away from the wall. Eli sat down with the bag in his lap, while Jay fetched the repair card. His earlier reply had been brusque, and Eli was still resentful about being treated as if the problem did not matter. Jay apologised without adding an excuse. Mina did not try to appease Eli with a discount on another bag. She offered to put the seam right that afternoon, at no extra charge. Jay wrote the offer clearly and checked that Eli could return at five. That did not remove all the resentment, but it gave them something concrete to agree on. When Eli came back, the lining lay flat. Jay showed him the repaired seam before reaching for a paper bag.

paragraphs.en:
Collection note for Eli
To make amends for the faulty seam, we will correct the lining today without a further charge. Collection after 5 p.m. Please examine the repair with Jay before taking the bag home.

S08.Q09.P01.function: A second conversation by the chairs
S08.Q09.P01.cue: 说说最初的回答和伊莱的感受。
acceptableAnswers: 杰伊先前的回答很唐突。 伊莱因被轻视而不满。

S08.Q09.P02.function: A second conversation by the chairs
S08.Q09.P02.cue: 说说伊莱仍有的情绪，以及米娜为什么没有用折扣来安抚他。
acceptableAnswers: 这个安排没有消除伊莱的全部不满。 米娜没有试图用折扣安抚伊莱。

S08.Q09.P03.function: A second conversation by the chairs
S08.Q09.P03.cue: 说明小店怎样弥补错误。
acceptableAnswers: 他们重新维修，弥补接缝错误。

S08.Q09.T01.function: A second conversation by the chairs
S08.Q09.T01.cue: 你给别人发错文件，提出具体补救，怎么说？
acceptableAnswers: 为弥补错误，我现在把正确文件发给你。
